source: complete unmodified Penumbra T2 bodies from consistent read-only snapshot
sampling: One body/source-session; seeded month/length/retention round-robin, shuffled; retention and source IDs withheld from reviewers. No prevalence claim.

lockedRecipes.name: nano-accept-first
lockedRecipes.rule: If native p>=0.5 accept; otherwise use unchanged Granite verdict; native failure falls back. No native negative veto.

developmentData: Previous T1/source reviewed cohort was used for recipe design and is not confirmatory cascade evidence
notMeasured: Actual downstream memory use over time; this corpus supports source-based offline utility review only.
reviewMethod: Two fresh blind AI source-check reviews, distinct AI adjudication of durability/factualSupport disputes; common model family, no human adjudication.
blindingCaveat: Current study predictions withheld. Some input bodies themselves contained older benchmark/model numbers; reviewers flagged those as unverified content. Report that slice separately.
negativeSampleLimit: Only14 independently AI-labeled negatives; cannot certify a2% false-promotion upper bound. Stratified source-family sample, not population prevalence.
